narrative: Material PL3__MDAB776E exhibits erratic demand patterns with a coefficient of variation of 0.67. The demand is characterized by a gamma distribution with mean daily demand of 285.22 units. Lead time variability is moderate (CV=0.85), averaging 1.50 days. The optimized inventory policy recommends a safety stock of 714 units and an order quantity of 5246 units (constrained by storage capacity of 5961 units). The reorder point is set at 1507 units to achieve a 95% service level. This optimization delivers annual cost savings of $2728.16 (69.2% reduction) compared to the current SAP policy. The recommended safety lead time is 2.5 days, primarily driven by transport variability.
